Hero.subtitle:
I create what others dream of making.
No matter how difficult.
I allways find a way.

intro.paragraph1: I''m <name>Stanisław Botwina</name>, a <role>full-stack developer</role> and UI designer from <country>Poland.</country> I like to create stuff that is diffrent from the colorfull gradiently <slop>slop</slop> generated by LLM''s.
intro.paragraph2: Each thing I create aims to be creative and unique enough to bring the visitor back. I also love working with people whether in large teams or cozy groups of friends.
intro.paragraph3: Around a year ago, I started working on a free mobile app called <appName>ZaliczTo.PL</appName>. It''s almost finished and you can join the <waitlist>waitlist</waitlist> to get to know as soon as it''s ready.
intro.paragraph4: Recently I got into <leetcode>LeetCode</leetcode> and I''m trying to solve a challange per day. It''s not easy but I''m learning a lot and I genuinely enjoy solving them.
intro.paragraph5: If you are interested in my work, don''t hesitate to contact me - I''ll reply as soon as humanly possible.
